# Main X Index (main-x-service)

> A federated identity index: ~55 self-contained Rust crates (loco.rs backend services + SvelteKit operator front-ends), one per real-world entity (person, worker, place, thing, event, course, organization, care pathway, case, plan/portfolio), each doing CRUD, probabilistic + deterministic matching, full-text search, record merge, an audit trail, and event streaming — plus a central SSO provider, a cross-service link-graph aggregator, and five consumer applications that build on the registries.

Each crate is self-contained (own REST API, own persistence, own matching algorithm) and shares an architecture and documentation layout, not code. Every subproject's spec/ directory is the single source of truth for that subproject; code conforms to the spec, not the reverse. This file describes the published documentation site (main-x-service.github.io), a curated front door — not the git checkout; every entry links to its GitHub source since the site itself renders only a handful of overview pages (see "This site" below).

## This site

- [Home](https://main-x-service.github.io/): Elevator pitch and at-a-glance facts about the Main X Index
- [Architecture](https://main-x-service.github.io/architecture/): Layered request flow, the two internal service shapes, cross-cutting subsystems
- [Subprojects](https://main-x-service.github.io/subprojects/): The full family index (services, matchers, libraries, front-ends, consumer apps, cross-cutting services), each linking to its GitHub source
- [About](https://main-x-service.github.io/about/): What this site is, spec-driven development, AI-assisted development, license

## Entity registry services (Rust, loco.rs)

- [person-service](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/person/person-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Person (general) identity registry
- [worker-service](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/worker/worker-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Worker (workforce/professional) identity registry, plus assessments
- [place-service](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/place/place-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Place registry (schema.org/Place)
- [thing-service](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/thing/thing-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Thing/asset registry (schema.org/Thing)
- [event-service](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/event/event-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Time-bounded event registry (schema.org/Event)
- [course-service](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/course/course-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Course-identity registry plus CourseInstance sub-resource
- [authentication-service](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/authentication/authentication-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Central SSO — passwordless magic-link, cookie sessions, PASETO v4.public issuance
- [organization-service](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/organization/organization-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Organization registry (schema.org/Organization); family FHIR reference implementation
- [care-pathway-service](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/care-pathway/care-pathway-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Clinical care-pathway registry
- [case-service](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/case/case-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Governmental case-tracking registry
- [project-portfolio-management-service](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Plan registry — one recursive tree; a full PM suite (goals/tasks/issues/timeline/burndown)

## Matcher crates (dependency-light comparison libraries)

- [person-matcher](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/person/person-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Demographic + multinational national-identifier matching
- [worker-matcher](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/worker/worker-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Workforce/professional identity matching
- [place-matcher](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/place/place-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Geographic/postal-address/venue matching
- [thing-matcher](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/thing/thing-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Generic thing/asset matching
- [event-matcher](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/event/event-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Time-bounded event matching
- [course-matcher](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/course/course-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Course matching (name, code, level, keywords)
- [organization-matcher](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/organization/organization-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Organization matching (name, address, LEI/DUNS/GLN/…)
- [care-pathway-matcher](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/care-pathway/care-pathway-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Clinical care-pathway matching
- [case-matcher](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/case/case-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Governmental case matching
- [project-portfolio-management-matcher](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Plan matching (no kind gate)

## Library crates (peer-side, not services or matchers)

- [authentication-verifier](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/authentication/authentication-verifier-rust-crate/index.md): Offline PASETO v4.public (Ed25519) verification; published to crates.io
- [integrity-mac](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/tree/main/integrity/integrity-mac-rust-crate/): Keyed integrity MACs (HMAC-SHA256) with production-grade key handling, embedded family-wide
- [entity-ref](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/tree/main/link/entity-ref-rust-crate/): The EntityRef URN type + the closed v1 EdgeKind registry for cross-service linking; published to crates.io as entity-ref

## Cross-cutting services

- [link-graph-service-with-loco](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/link/link-graph-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Read-model aggregator for cross-service entity linking; carries the family's original OpenTelemetry OTLP exporter

## GitHub Pages

- [main-x-service.github.io/](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/main-x-service.github.io/index.md): Public documentation front door for this monorepo (SvelteKit + Lily Design System, static/prerendered); published via git subtree to a sibling read-only repo, see spec/monorepo-github-pages/

## Front-end projects (SvelteKit operator SPAs)

- [person-front-end-with-svelte](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/person/person-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI for Person CRUD/search/match/merge/audit
- [worker-front-end-with-svelte](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/worker/worker-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI for Worker

- [thing-front-end-with-svelte](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/thing/thing-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI for Thing
- [event-front-end-with-svelte](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/event/event-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI for Event
- [course-front-end-with-svelte](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/course/course-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI for Course
- [authentication-front-end-with-svelte](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/authentication/authentication-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Passwordless magic-link sign up/in/out UI
- [organization-front-end-with-svelte](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/organization/organization-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI for Organization
- [care-pathway-front-end-with-svelte](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/care-pathway/care-pathway-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI for care pathways
- [case-front-end-with-svelte](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/case/case-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI for governmental cases
- [project-portfolio-management-front-end-with-svelte](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI plus Kanban/Gantt/burndown project-management views

## Consumer applications (build on the registries)

- [case-folder](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/case-folder/spec/index.md): NHS paper case-note folder location tracking
- [patient-flow](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/patient-flow/spec/index.md): NHS hospital bed management and ward whiteboards
- [workforce-planning-management](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/workforce-planning-management/spec/index.md): All-in-one HR across the employee lifecycle
- [contact-relationship-management](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/contact-relationship-management/spec/index.md): Customer/prospect relationships (sales, marketing, service, support)
- [content-management-system](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/content-management-system/spec/index.md): Headless content management (block documents, assets, editorial lifecycle)

- [agents/share/cross-service-linking.md](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/agents/share/cross-service-linking.md): The hybrid write-local + read-model-aggregator link topology
- [agents/share/bulk-import-export.md](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/agents/share/bulk-import-export.md): Async bulk import/export (JSONL/CSV/Parquet)
- [agents/share/availability.md](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/agents/share/availability.md): Scaling, health checks, graceful shutdown
- [agents/share/observability.md](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/agents/share/observability.md): Tracing + OpenTelemetry rollout status
- [agents/share/restful.md](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/agents/share/restful.md): RESTful API conventions and pagination
- [agents/share/fhir.md](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/agents/share/fhir.md): HL7 FHIR R5 API design and per-entity resource mapping
- [agents/share/api-versioning.md](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/agents/share/api-versioning.md): Header-based API versioning (Accepts-version)
- [agents/share/loco.md](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/agents/share/loco.md): The loco.rs framework conventions used family-wide
- [agents/share/rust-loco-stack.md](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/agents/share/rust-loco-stack.md): The full Rust + loco dependency stack
- [agents/share/postgresql.md](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/agents/share/postgresql.md): PostgreSQL setup, extensions, the local test database
- [agents/share/compliance-for-healthcare.md](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/agents/share/compliance-for-healthcare.md): HIPAA, NHS, EHDS, ONC/HTI, IEC 62304
- [agents/share/compliance-for-technology.md](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/agents/share/compliance-for-technology.md): GDPR, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 42001
- [agents/share/locales.md](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/agents/share/locales.md): Supported locales for i18n/l10n
- [agents/share/configuration.md](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/agents/share/configuration.md): The complete environment-variable reference

## Continuous integration & policy

- [.github/workflows/ci.yml](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml): GitHub CI pipeline (fmt, clippy, test, test-db, deny, evidence, fuzz, msrv, bench)
- [.woodpecker.yml](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/.woodpecker.yml): Codeberg CI pipeline — byte-identical stages to ci.yml
- [scripts/ci-check.sh](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/scripts/ci-check.sh): Run any CI stage locally, exactly as CI runs it
- [ci/msrv.txt](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/ci/msrv.txt): The declared Minimum Supported Rust Version (current stable minus two)
- [ci/db-suites.txt](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/ci/db-suites.txt): The allowlist of crates whose --ignored Postgres suite runs in CI
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/SECURITY.md): How to report a vulnerability
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution ground rules
- [GOVERNANCE.md](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md): Sole-maintainer governance
- [LICENSE.md](https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service/blob/main/LICENSE.md): Per-subproject SPDX license expressions
